parameters.query: SELECT a.id, a.url, a.title, a.summary, a.key_points, c.name as category, ni.beehiiv_url as newsletter_url FROM articles a LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN newsletter_section_articles nsa ON nsa.article_id = a.id LEFT JOIN newsletter_sections ns ON ns.id = nsa.section_id LEFT JOIN newsletter_issues ni ON ni.id = ns.issue_id WHERE a.status = 'published' AND a.id NOT IN (SELECT article_id FROM social_posts WHERE status IN ('posted', 'scheduled')) AND ni.status IN ('sending', 'sent') ORDER BY a.final_score DESC LIMIT 5
